brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a maintenance service visit for the primary air conditioning unit at home.
facts: The primary unit has not been cooling efficiently for two weeks.
The service location address is 742 Evergreen Terrace.
There is also a second smaller unit upstairs installed last year.
preferences: Would like both units serviced if a discount applies, but will prioritize the main unit.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit including the call-out fee and any parts fitted

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, new installations on 2, billing on 3.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: IVR Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Auto and Climate Care. For service, press 1. For new installations, press 2. For billing inquiries, press 3.

script.label: Representative Greeting
script.text: Thanks for calling service scheduling, my name is Alex. How can I assist you today?

script.label: Clarification Request
script.text: Got it, I can certainly help get that scheduled for you. Could I have your service address?

script.label: Pricing Quote
script.text: Standard comprehensive maintenance on that main system is exactly 160 dollars.

script.label: Inquiry on Secondary Unit
script.text: I see on your account history that you also have a second unit upstairs; would you like us to inspect that one during the same visit?

script.label: Appointment Proposal
script.text: We have an opening for our technician to arrive tomorrow between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

script.label: Confirmation Request
script.text: Would you like me to go ahead and lock in that 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM slot for your service visit?

script.label: Final Booking Confirmation
script.text: You are all set for tomorrow between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Thank you for choosing Apex, and have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
